_comment: Engine-owned smoke scene for clustered decals (docs/DECALS.md). Receivers: a static wall, a rigidbody (dynamic) box, a transmissive sphere (transparent pass). 300 overlapping, seed-jittered decals tile the wall; a stack of 270 decals on one spot exceeds the 256-per-cluster cap, so the cull must flag overflow bit 1 and never bit 2 (index list full). Textures are the committed prototype grids only, so CI needs no Drive assets. No skinned receiver: no skinned model is in git (smoke_min's pre-skin self-test covers the skinning shader). Regenerate with tools/gen_smoke_decals.py; checked by the smoke_decals block in main.cpp.
